Suggested inquiry: Mushroom Vision is an unfinished open-source project building
human-reviewed mushroom image datasets and vision experiments. Our code is
available at https://github.com/Arthurman70/mushroom-vision. We would like to
understand whether your collection can be used for model training and evaluation,
whether derived weights may be released, and what attribution, commercial-use,
and redistribution conditions apply. We do not claim clinical validation or
verified autonomous field performance. We can keep restricted material in a
separate research collection and will preserve your provenance requirements.
